label: SPE

registers.name: PMSICR_EL1
registers.description: SPE 间接控制寄存器。为 SPE 提供间接控制机制。FEAT_SPE 时存在。

fields.name: ECOUNT
fields.description: [When FEAT_SPE_ERnd is implemented] Secondary sample interval 计数er. 提供 the secondary 计数er used after the primary 计数er reaches zero. While the secondary 计数er is nonzero and profiling is 使能, the secondary 计数er decrements by 1 for each member of the sample population. The primary 计数er also continues to decrement since it is also nonzero. When the secondary 计数er reaches zero, a member of the sampling population is selected for sampling.；否则为 RES0

fields.name: COUNT
fields.description: Primary sample interval 计数er. 提供 the primary 计数er used for sampling. When the PE moves from a state or Exception level where profiling is 禁用 to a state or Exception level where profiling is 使能, if 值 this register is zero, then the primary 计数er is loaded from PMSIRR_EL1. While the primary 计数er is nonzero and sampling is 使能, the primary 计数er decrements by 1 for each member of the sample population. The sample interval 计数er 计数s either a number of 操作s or a number of instructions, depending on the IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED value of PMSIDR_EL1.ArchInst. When the 计数er reaches zero, the behavior depends on 值 PMSIRR_EL1.RND and whether FEAT_SPE_ERnd is implemented: The primary 计数er is loaded from PMSIRR_EL1 means: For more information, see Initializing the sample interval 计数ers and Behavior of the sample interval 计数er while profiling is 使能.
